special_dependencies.detail: Three overlapping surfaces share employee_* / hr_* tables. Selling Staff without HR may still need limited employee master data.
Driver app is weakly useful without Delivery desk; Delivery often needs Online or POS orders.
Player alone only shows pairing; requires Centre (or Admin approve) to function.
Both need products/categories; Drive-Thru also couples to POS station workflows.
Online-specific gifts need Online; POS redemption needs POS.
Turning off Comms should stop WhatsApp/SMS/email jobs globally even if other modules remain.
Accounting journals may still receive posts from sales/expenses; gating must decide whether to stop posting or only hide UI.
Recipe components hang off products; disabling Recipe should not delete products.
investor_enabled / release_enabled / meeting_enabled already exist in biz_module_settings — precursor to entitlements.
Two marketing schemas in DB; confirm which is live before gating Referral.

decisions_needed: Should Admin Panel always be included, with packages only toggling admin.* submodules?
Sell Staff Portal separately from full HR/Payroll, or only as one People pack?
Is Branding a standalone paid add-on or included with Online Ordering?
Bundle Signage Player with Signage Centre always?
When Accounting is off: hide UI only, or also suppress automatic journal posts from POS/expenses?
Treat legacy marketing_* tables as dead (ignore) or still part of Referral?
Is Apprentice Centre expected later? (not present in codebase today)
Donations / Owner salary / EOM — add-ons or free with HR?
